summary: Our project, "The machines we left behind" explores NASA's machines left on the Moon and Mars, including the Lunar Roving Vehicle, Sojourner, and Opportunity. We will explain their history, purpose, discoveries, and what happened after their missions ended.
details:
The Machines We Left Behind is an educational board game designed to teach players how NASA's robotic explorers work. These machines are sent into space to explore planets, collect information, take pictures, and help scientists understand places that humans have not visited yet.

In this game, players will take on the role of space explorers controlling a robotic rover on Mars. They will face different challenges, answer questions, and learn about the technology used by NASA robots.
